title: 戒清净
note: 身口意、活命、惭愧、少欲、知量

evidence.pali: 193 . ‘‘So evaṃ pabbajito samāno pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu, kāyakammavacīkammena samannāgato kusalena, parisuddhājīvo sīlasampanno, indriyesu guttadvāro guttadvāro, bhojane mattaññū (ka.) , satisampajaññena samannāgato, santuṭṭho.
evidence.chinese_simplified: 193. 他如是出家后，守护波罗提木叉律仪而住，具足正行与行处，于微细罪中见怖畏，受持学习诸学处；具足善的身业与语业，活命清净，戒行具足，守护诸根门，具足念与正知，知足。
evidence.english: 193. “Having thus gone forth, he dwells restrained by the Pātimokkha restraint, possessed of good conduct and resort, seeing danger in the slightest faults. He undertakes and trains in the training rules, is endowed with wholesome bodily and verbal action, has a purified livelihood, is perfected in virtue, has guarded doors in his sense faculties, is endowed with mindfulness and clear comprehension, and is content.

isolation_reason: 旧图保留的独立概念有直接 V4 逐句证据，但当前闭包没有足够直接的关系句将其连接到另一发布节点；为避免凭概念相似度补边，保留为可检索、可引用的独立节点。

entries.pali: 135-142 . Sīlavināsikā asaṃvarasaṅkhātā sīlassa vipatti sīlavipatti . Sammādiṭṭhivināsikā micchādiṭṭhisaṅkhātā diṭṭhiyā vipatti diṭṭhivipatti . Soraccameva sīlassa sampādanato sīlaparipūraṇato sīlassa sampadāti sīlasampadā . Diṭṭhipāripūribhūtaṃ ñāṇaṃ diṭṭhiyā sampadāti diṭṭhisampadā . Visuddhibhāvaṃ sampattā sīlasaṅkhātā sīlassa visuddhi, sīlavisuddhi . Nibbānasaṅkhātaṃ visuddhiṃ pāpetuṃ samatthā, dassanasaṅkhātā, diṭṭhiyā visuddhi diṭṭhivisuddhi . Diṭṭhivisuddhi kho pana yathādiṭṭhissa ca padhāna nti kammassakataññāṇādisaṅkhātā diṭṭhivisuddhi ceva yathādiṭṭhissa ca anurūpadiṭṭhissa kalyāṇadiṭṭhissa taṃsampayuttameva padhānaṃ. Saṃvego ti jātiādīni paṭicca uppannabhayasaṅkhātaṃ saṃvijjanaṃ. Saṃvejaniyaṭṭhāna nti saṃvegajanakaṃ jātiādikāraṇaṃ. Saṃviggassa ca yonisopadhāna nti evaṃ saṃvegajātassa upāyapadhānaṃ. Asantuṭṭhitā ca kusalesu dhammesū ti kusaladhammapūraṇe asantuṭṭhibhāvo. Appaṭivānitā ca padhānasmi nti arahattaṃ apatvā padhānasmiṃ anivattanatā anosakkanatā. Vijānanato vijjā . Vimuccanato vimutti. Khaye ñāṇa nti kilesakkhayakare ariyamagge ñāṇaṃ. Anuppāde ñāṇa nti paṭisandhivasena anuppādabhūte taṃtaṃmaggavajjhakilesānaṃ anuppādapariyosāne uppanne ariyaphale ñāṇaṃ. Ayaṃ mātikāya anupubbapadavaṇṇanā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 135-142. 毁坏戒者，即名为不防护的戒之败坏，是为戒败坏。毁坏正见者，即名为邪见的见之败坏，是为见败坏。仅是柔和便能成就戒、圆满戒，是为戒成就。圆满见的智慧，是为见成就。已达清净状态的戒，是为戒清净。能够导向名为涅槃(Nibbāna)之清净的见，是为见清净。又，见清净及如实见者之精进，即名为业自作智等的见清净，以及与如实见者、随顺见者、善见者相应的精进。悚惧，即缘于生等而生起的名为怖畏的惊悚。悚惧处，即产生悚惧的生等原因。已生悚惧者的如理精进，即是如此生起悚惧者的方便精进。于诸善法不满足，即于圆满诸善法时不满足的状态。于精进不退转，即未达阿罗汉果(arahatta)前，于精进中不退转、不退却。因了知，故为明(vijjā)。因解脱，故为解脱(vimutti)。尽智(khaye ñāṇa)，即于能灭尽烦恼的圣道之智。无生智(anuppāde ñāṇa)，即于以结生方式不再生起、于彼彼道所断之烦恼不生为终结时所生起的圣果之智。此为《论母》(Mātikā)之次第句释义。
entries.english: 135-142. The failure of virtue, designated as non-restraint, which is destructive of virtue, is failure of virtue. The failure of view, designated as wrong view, which is destructive of right view, is failure of view. The accomplishment of virtue is so called from accomplishing and fulfilling virtue through amiability itself. The accomplishment of view is knowledge that has become the fulfillment of view. The purification of virtue is virtue, designated as having attained a state of purity. The purification of view is designated as seeing, which is able to lead to the purity designated as Nibbāna. Moreover, the purification of view is the exertion of one who sees rightly; that is, it is both the purification of view designated as knowledge of kamma's ownership, etc., and the very exertion associated with that of one who sees rightly, whose view is in accordance, whose view is wholesome. Spiritual urgency is agitation, designated as fear arisen dependent on birth, etc. A cause for spiritual urgency is a cause that generates spiritual urgency, such as birth, etc. And for one who is spiritually urgent, proper exertion is the exertion of means. And dissatisfaction with wholesome qualities is the state of not being content in the fulfillment of wholesome qualities. And not turning back in exertion is the state of not turning back, not retreating, in exertion until attaining arahantship. From knowing comes knowledge. From being liberated comes liberation. Knowledge of destruction is the knowledge in the Noble Path that causes the destruction of defilements. Knowledge of non-arising is the knowledge in the Noble Fruit that arises at the culmination of the non-arising of those defilements to be abandoned by the respective path, which has become non-arising by way of rebirth-linking. This is the sequential explanation of the terms in the matrix.

entries.pali: Athassa amaccaputtassa mattikāmattena nhāpanaṃ viya kulaputtassāpi pabbajjāpaṭilābho. Athassa thūlasāṭakanivāsanaṃ viya imassāpi dasasikkhāpadasaṅkhātasīlavatthanivāsanaṃ. Puna tassa gandhodakanhāpanaṃ viya imassāpi pātimokkhasaṃvarādisīlagandhodakanhāpanaṃ. Puna tassa sukhumadukūlayugaḷacchādanaṃ viya imassāpi yathāvuttasīlavisuddhisampadāsaṅkhātadukūlacchādanaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 其次，大臣之子以细泥沐浴，犹如良家子获得出家。其次，他穿上粗布衣，犹如此良家子穿上名为十学处的戒衣。复次，他以香水沐浴，犹如此良家子以波罗提木叉律仪等戒律之香水沐浴。复次，他披上一对柔软的细绢衣，犹如此良家子披上名为‘如前所述之戒清净圆满’的细绢衣。
entries.english: Then, just as that minister's son was bathed with fine clay, so too is the attainment of the going forth for this son of good family. Just as he was clothed in a coarse garment, so too is the clothing of this one in the garment of virtue called the ten training rules. Again, just as he was bathed with perfumed water, so too is the bathing of this one with the perfumed water of virtue, such as the Pātimokkha restraint. Again, just as he was covered with a pair of fine linen cloths, so too is the covering of this one with the fine garment called the accomplishment of purity of virtue as described.

entries.pali: Dukūlacchāditassa panassa pāsādāropanaṃ viya imassāpi sīlavisuddhidukūlacchāditassa samādhibhāvanāpāsādārohanaṃ. Tato tassa subhojanabhuñjanaṃ viya imassāpi samādhiupakārakasatisampajaññādidhammāmataparibhuñjanaṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 再者，犹如为身穿白衣者送上宫殿，这位身穿戒清净(sīlavisuddhi)白衣的善男子亦登上定修习(samādhibhāvanā)之宫殿。其后，犹如他享用美食，这位善男子亦享用有助于定之正念(sati)、正知(sampajañña)等法之甘露。
entries.english: Furthermore, just as for that one, covered with a fine garment, there was the being led up to the palace, so too for this one, covered with the fine garment of purity of virtue, there is the ascending of the palace of the development of concentration. Then, just as for that one there was the partaking of excellent food, so too for this one there is the partaking of the ambrosia of qualities beneficial to concentration, such as mindfulness and clear comprehension.

entries.pali: 793-794 . Navattabbaṃsaṅghodakkhiṇaṃvisodhetītikathāyaṃ na ca tāni dakkhiṇaṃ visodhetuṃ sakkontī ti yathā puggalo sīlaparisodhanādīni katvā nirodhampi samāpajjitvā visodhetuṃ sakkoti, na evaṃ maggaphalānīti adhippāyo, appaṭiggahaṇatoti vā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 793-794. 在“不应说僧团净化供养”论中，“彼等不能净化供养”之意趣为：犹如个人(puggala)行持戒清净等，乃至入灭尽定，能令（供养）清净，道与果却非如是。或因其不纳受。
entries.english: 793-794. In the Discourse that One Should Not Say, 'The Sangha Purifies the Offering,' the intention of the passage 'and those are not able to purify the offering' is this: just as a person is able to purify an offering by doing such things as purifying his virtue and even attaining cessation, the paths and fruits are not able to do so in the same way; or because they are not recipients.

entries.pali: 31 . Ātāpanaṃ kilesānaṃ vibādhanaṃ pahānaṃ. Padahanaṃ kosajjapakkhe patituṃ adatvā cittassa ussahanaṃ. Anuyogo yathā samādhi visesabhāgiyataṃ pāpuṇāti, evaṃ vīriyassa bahulīkaraṇaṃ. Idha upacārappanācittaparidamanavīriyānaṃ adhippetattā āha ‘‘tippabhedaṃ vīriya’’ nti . Nappamajjati etenāti appamādo, asammoso. Sammā upāyena manasi karoti kammaṭṭhānaṃ etenāti sammāmanasikāro ñāṇanti āha ‘‘vīriyañca satiñca ñāṇañcā’’ ti. Etthā ti ‘‘ātappa…pe… manasikāraṃ anvāyā’’ti imasmiṃ pāṭhe. Sīlavisuddhiyā saddhiṃ catunnaṃ rūpāvacarajjhānānaṃ adhigamanapaṭipadā vattabbā, sā pana visuddhimagge vitthārato vuttāti āha ‘‘saṅkhepattho’’ ti. ‘‘Tathārūpa’’ nti cuddasavidhehi cittadamanehi rūpāvacaracatutthajjhānassa damitataṃ vadati.
entries.chinese_simplified: 31. 热忱(ātāpana)是烧灼、断除烦恼。策励(padahana)是不让心落入懈怠一方，而令其振奋。随行(anuyoga)是多修精进，以使定能达到殊胜的境地。此处意指调伏心以达近行(upacāra)与安止(appanā)的精进，故说‘三种精进’。不因此而放逸，故为不放逸(appamāda)，即不忘失。因此而以正确的方法作意业处(kammaṭṭhāna)，故为正作意(sammāmanasikāra)，即是慧，故说‘精进、念与慧’。在此，即在‘依于热忱……乃至……作意’这段经文中。与戒清净(sīlavisuddhi)一起，应当说明四种色界禅(rūpāvacarajjhāna)的证得之道，但那已在《清净道论》(Visuddhimagga)中详细解说，故说‘此为简义’。‘如是’(tathārūpa)是指以十四种调心法调伏色界第四禅的已调伏状态。
entries.english: 31. Ardor is the tormenting and abandoning of defilements. Exertion is the rousing of the mind, not allowing it to fall into the side of laziness. Application is the cultivation of energy in such a way that concentration attains a distinctive quality. Here, because energy for taming the mind in both access and absorption is intended, it is said, 'threefold energy.' 'Heedfulness' (appamāda) is not being negligent; it is non-confusion. 'Right attention' (sammāmanasikāra) is knowledge, whereby one rightly and skillfully attends to the meditation subject; thus it is said, 'energy, mindfulness, and knowledge.' Here, in this passage 'ardor... up to attention,' the path of practice for the attainment of the four form-sphere jhānas together with the purification of virtue should be stated. But since that is explained in detail in the Visuddhimagga, it is said, 'this is the meaning in brief.' 'Of such a kind' refers to the fact that the fourth form-sphere jhāna has been tamed by the fourteen methods of taming the mind.

entries.pali: Piṇḍatthā pana āghātādīnaṃ akaraṇīyatāvacanena paṭiññānurūpaṃ samaṇasaññāya niyojanaṃ, khantisoraccānuṭṭhānaṃ, brahmavihārabhāvanānuyogo, saddhāpaññāsamāyogo, satisampajaññādhiṭṭhānaṃ, paṭisaṅkhānabhāvanābalasiddhi, pariyuṭṭhānānusayappahānaṃ, ubhayahitapaṭipatti, lokadhammehi anupalepo ca dassitā honti. Tathā pāṇātipātādīhi paṭivirativacanena sīlavisuddhi dassitā, tāya ca hirottappasampatti, mettākaruṇāsamaṅgitā , vītikkamappahānaṃ, tadaṅgapahānaṃ, duccaritasaṃkilesappahānaṃ, viratittayasiddhi, piyamanāpagarubhāvanīyatānipphatti, lābhasakkārasilokasamudāgamo, samathavipassanānaṃ adhiṭṭhānabhāvo, akusalamūlatanukaraṇaṃ, kusalamūlaropanaṃ, ubhayānatthadūrīkaraṇaṃ, parisāsu visāradatā, appamādavihāro,parehi duppadhaṃsiyatā, avippaṭisārādisamaṅgitā ca dassitā honti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 至于总义，则开示了：通过教导不应有嗔恼等，而致力于符合其誓言的沙门之想；修习忍耐与柔和；致力于修习梵住(brahmavihāra)；信与慧的结合；安住于念与正知(sati-sampajañña)；成就省察修习之力；断除缠与随眠；实践自他二利；以及不为世间法所染。同样地，通过教导戒除杀生等，开示了戒清净(sīlavisuddhi)，并由此开示了：成就惭与愧(hiri-ottappa)；具足慈与悲；断除违越；彼分断；断除恶行之杂染；成就三离(virattittaya)；成就可爱、可意、可敬、可重；获得利养、恭敬与名声；成为止与观(samatha-vipassanā)的基础；减损不善根；培植善根；远离于双方无益之事；于诸众中无畏；安住于不放逸；不为他人所倾动；以及具足无悔等。
entries.english: Moreover, the summary meanings shown are: by the statement of the non-doing of hatred and the like, the commitment to the perception of an ascetic in accordance with one's vow; the practice of patience and gentleness; engagement in the cultivation of the divine abodes; the combination of faith and wisdom; the establishment of mindfulness and clear comprehension; the accomplishment of strength through reflective cultivation; the abandonment of obsessional and underlying defilements; the practice beneficial to both oneself and others; and being unsullied by worldly conditions. Likewise, by the statement of refraining from killing living beings and so on, the purification of virtue is shown. Through this are also shown: the attainment of moral shame and fear of wrongdoing; the possession of loving-kindness and compassion; the abandonment of transgression; abandonment by substitution; the abandonment of misconduct and defilement; the accomplishment of the threefold abstinence; the attainment of being dear, agreeable, respected, and venerable; the arising of gain, honor, and fame; the state of being a foundation for serenity and insight; the attenuation of unwholesome roots; the planting of wholesome roots; the removal of what is disadvantageous to both; confidence in assemblies; dwelling in heedfulness; being difficult to overcome by others; and the possession of non-remorse and the like.

entries.pali: 119-123 . Ito pubbe parikamma ntiādinā samāpattivuṭṭhānakusalatā viya samāpattikusalatāpi jhānalābhīnaṃyeva hotīti vuttaṃ viya dissati. ‘‘Itaresampi anussavavasena samāpattīnaṃ appanāparicchedapaññā labbhatī’’ti vadanti. ‘‘Evaṃ sīlavisodhanādinā samāpattiṃ appetīti jānanakapaññā saha parikammena appanāparicchedajānanakapaññā’’ti keci. Vuṭṭhāne kusalabhāvo vuṭṭhānavasitā. Pubbe ti samāpajjanato pubbe.
entries.chinese_simplified: 119-123. 在此之前，由“加行”等句，似乎是说：犹如入定与出定善巧，入定善巧亦唯禅定获得者所有。有人说：“其他人亦能由听闻传承而获得入定的决断智慧。”有些人说：“‘如是，由戒清净等而入定’，此了知慧，是与加行俱的入定决断了知慧。”于出定之善巧，即出定自在。“先前”即入定之前。
entries.english: 119-123. Before this, by “preparatory work,” etc., it seems to have been said that skill in attainment, like skill in emerging from attainment, belongs only to those who have attained jhāna. Some say: “Even for others, the wisdom that discerns the delimitation of absorption can be acquired through oral tradition.” Others say: “The wisdom that knows, ‘Thus one attains absorption through purification of virtue, etc.,’ is the wisdom that knows the delimitation of absorption, together with preparatory work.” Skillfulness in emerging is mastery in emerging. “Before” means before attaining absorption.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Sīlaṃ cittavisuddhi ñca, sampādetvā tato paraṃ; Diṭṭhisuddhādayo pañca, sampādentena suddhiyā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 成就戒清净与心清净，再以成就见清净等五种清净的方式，
entries.english: Then, having perfected virtue and the purification of mind, he should accomplish the five purities beginning with the purity of view.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Catupārisuddhisīlaṃ, dhutaṅgaparivāritaṃ; Sīlavisuddhisaṅkhātaṃ, pūrayitvā tato paraṃ.
entries.chinese_simplified: 圆满以头陀行为助缘、名为戒清净的四遍净戒后，其次……
entries.english: Having first fulfilled the purification of virtue, which consists in the fourfold purification of morality and is accompanied by the ascetic practices,
